## Summary

I implemented `listResources` and `readResource` in `server.mjs` and wired them into the protocol dispatcher in `protocol.mjs`.

**`server.mjs`:**
- `listResources()` advertises a resource template `users/{user_id}/profile` with `mimeType: text/plain`, plus an empty `resources` array.
- `readResource(uri)` validates the input, matches the URI against the strict pattern `users/{user_id}/profile`, and returns the matching URI plus a text body for `u1` (Ada Lovelace) and `u2` (Alan Turing). It rejects non-string/empty URIs, unknown URI patterns (e.g. `posts/u1/profile`), and unknown users (e.g. `u3`) with `-32602` errors.

**`protocol.mjs`:**
- Imports the new handlers and dispatches `resources/list`, `resources/templates/list`, and `resources/read`, and advertises a `resources` capability on `initialize`.

The included test passes, and end-to-end protocol checks confirm the happy paths and the two rejection paths (unknown pattern and unknown user) behave correctly.
